question:
Choose the idiom/phrase that can substitute the highlighted group of words meaningfully.

The automobile industry is **the source of livelihood** of many people of Manesar.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"Bread and butter"** refers to someone's main source of income or livelihood. (रोटी और मक्खन)

 
 
• **Example: **Teaching is her **bread and butter**; without it, she wouldn't be able to support her family.
 
 
 
• **"Source of livelihood" **means the means of securing the necessities of life. (जीविका का स्रोत)
 
 
• **Example: **The fishing industry is the primary** source of livelihood **for the coastal communities.
 
 

Therefore, the correct idiom for the given phrase is** "Bread and butter."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **In the same boat** (एक ही नाव में): In the same difficult situation as someone else.

 
 
• **Example:** We're all** in the same boat**, trying to make ends meet.
 
 
 
• **Through thick and thin** (सुख-दुःख में): Under all circumstances, no matter how difficult.
 
 
• **Example:** They remained friends** through thick and thin.**
 
 
 
• **Go down the drain** (बर्बाद होना): To be wasted or lost.
 
 
• **Example:** All our efforts **went down the drain** when the project was canceled.
